draft.title: Taccuino del giorno · 22 settembre 2026
draft.excerpt: Due movimenti importanti nel settore giovanile azzurro: cambio in panchina per l'Under 19 e nuovo portiere in Serie A.
draft.excerptEn: Two important moves in the Italian youth sector: a coaching change for the U19 and a new goalkeeper in Serie A.
draft.bodyIt:
Continua il lavoro di rinnovamento nel vivaio della nazionale.

**Under 19 Italia**
Forfait di Longoni per la selezione azzurra: Favo convoca Andrea Maran al suo posto nella rosa della categoria. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNWVVYWDE0T2JicUxEOXl3RGtheVR5b1k2TVpBcmxyMGE4UV9kQlBadm9MdldaTW95dmJuYzVBWWw2cEJTQ2taSnhqWTQtbWFidENMMUppSnNEUUN1QUY4TGsxWTdIV2xrbV9sOEx2ODBBZWF6SnlMYnRsVEVvT2hFUmUyYlBNbW5FTnhJamF2RkdYSVkxR1BfM1BTbGFXY1ozeUxYQ0E3b3BvLUpwQXlRNg?oc=5)

**Sebastiano Desplanches**
Il portiere approda al Frosinone in Serie A e si aggregherà oggi al ritiro della squadra al Terminillo per l'inizio della preparazione. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQN0RQZldweHZiSWNBUDdIcFNsMEhyTE5nNVFYY1E1akdyblBDZTBvUGl4ZEkxM1V5UkY3UlkzdnAzWWdscExEeDVDVVE5OW11eld6RlFDOENpaXhaazdOcXhsaXF3OGdZYWNkWjZLX281V3JXS25jc3FMU3JHT3BTdDFlN093VzFQbzZoZGNXU1hZdzFLc2ZkMWM3cF91dUw3VEZUVnVMN25Vdm9NVEhoWGRFMFFtR193WDBZVkg1X2w?oc=5)
draft.bodyEn:
The overhaul of the national team's youth sector continues.

**Under 19 Italy**
Longoni is unavailable for the Azzurri selection: coach Favo calls up Andrea Maran to replace him in the squad. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNWVVYWDE0T2JicUxEOXl3RGtheVR5b1k2TVpBcmxyMGE4UV9kQlBadm9MdldaTW95dmJuYzVBWWw2cEJTQ2taSnhqWTQtbWFidENMMUppSnNEUUN1QUY4TGsxWTdIV2xrbV9sOEx2ODBBZWF6SnlMYnRsVEVvT2hFUmUyYlBNbW5FTnhJamF2RkdYSVkxR1BfM1BTbGFXY1ozeUxYQ0E3b3BvLUpwQXlRNg?oc=5)

**Sebastiano Desplanches**
The goalkeeper joins Frosinone in Serie A and will report to the squad's training camp at Terminillo today to begin preparation.
